fusions.name: Back-Spike Trip
fusions.desc: Catches the target's leg with the back-spike and brings the blade down. It deals 16 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Headsman's Reach
fusions.desc: Pulls the target's head down and drops the edge on it, dealing 24 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Timber Skid
fusions.desc: Pulls a felled trunk 5 tiles long across the ground for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Neck on the Block
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 9 seconds.
